howToAdd: Copy this file to .graphify/bind-rules.json (or the store folder Resolve is using). Each rule is one object. require = this screen/slot must use this exact master name or id. forbid = do not place that status or name. prefer = rank this library above that one. Unknown ids fail validation — never guess. Rules never change by themselves; approve a SOCI proposal with: npm run resolve -- approve <id>
